rules.title: General Laws Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 15B
rules.requirement: A lessor may require at or before tenancy start only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of no more than first month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Deposits must be held in a separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account, earn 5% interest (or the lesser bank rate) annually, and be returned within 30 days of the tenancy ending, less permitted deductions with an itemized sworn list. A statement of condition and receipts are required.
rules.key_value: Security deposit capped at 1 month's rent; interest 5% per year; return within 30 days
rules.penalty: Lessor forfeits the right to retain any of the deposit. Tenant is awarded three times the deposit plus 5% interest, court costs and attorney's fees. Unpaid interest is penalized at three times the interest owed.
rules.status_basis: Section appears in the General Laws; the 2025 amendment (2025, 9) is effective August 1, 2025.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential real property leases and tenancies.

rules.title: General Laws Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 15B (upfront charges)
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, no lessor or agent may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of up to one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Lessors must give receipts for advance payments. A fee in lieu of a deposit may be authorized by regulation, capped at one month's rent in total.
rules.key_value: Upfront payments limited to first month, last month, deposit of 1 month, and key/lock cost
rules.status_basis: Section appears in the General Laws; the amendment extending the limit to agents is effective August 1, 2025.
